name: date-input
purpose: Keyboard-first date or date-time entry using locale-ordered numeric segments. Produces explicit types: PlainDate (date granularity) or Instant (minute granularity) resolved in the configured timezone with a documented DST policy.
whenToUse: Entering known dates such as birth dates or due dates.
Entering an exact moment (meeting time) in a specific timezone.
whenNotToUse: Browsing dates visually: use Date Picker or DateTime Picker. Choosing ranges: use Date Range Picker.
responsive: Segments wrap inside the group on narrow containers; group width fits its content up to 100%.
rtl: Segment order follows the locale's Intl pattern; digits stay LTR (isolated). Arrow-key segment navigation mirrors in RTL.
theme: Control surface, focus and error tokens. Focused segment uses selected colors; forced-colors mode uses Highlight/HighlightText.
timezone: Minute granularity resolves wall-clock input in the `timezone` option or configuration (default UTC, never the host zone). Nonexistent/ambiguous times follow `disambiguation` (default compatible) and the user is told when a time was adjusted or which occurrence was used; `reject` produces a validation error. A hint shows the zone name and offset.
security: All text via textContent; no HTML parsing. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. A hidden input carries an ISO 8601 value (YYYY-MM-DD or UTC instant) when `name` is set.

performance.testedScale: 100 instances on one page in the performance test.

limitations: Minute granularity only; seconds are not editable.
Timezone rule accuracy depends on the browser's ICU data (SPEC section 8.7).
Incomplete and required errors are shown after the group loses focus or reportValidity() is called; other errors show immediately.
antiPatterns: Using minute granularity for date-only concepts such as birthdays (use date granularity to avoid timezone shifts).
Relying on the host timezone; always configure `timezone` explicitly for user-facing times.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/date-input: AuiDateInput directive ([auiDateInput]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/date-input: AuiDateInput component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
